title: Webbed Cloister
shortDescription: An old abbey walk taken over by silk, with one lantern still burning.
longDescription:
This cloister belonged to the abbey that stood before the Collegium. Silk has taken the arches without breaking the stone. A lantern hangs in a web, still lit.
South, the silk thickens. Something small moves there when you stop walking.

fixtures.name: Caught Lantern
fixtures.lookDescription: A Collegium lantern still burning in silk. Examine it.
fixtures.examineDescription: The lantern still burns a blue Collegium flame. Silk holds it up as neat as a shelf. The brass is dented where a keeper's hook used to clip. A tiny scratched H is on the base, the sort of mark you make when two moles share a kit. Nobody is trapped in this web. The mole who hung this light meant to come back. He has not.
